shortDescription.en: Close your business the legal way.

Your original business license
Tax clearance letter

text.en: If you have employees: staff list or payment letter

title.om: Gibira hin kaffalamme waajjira gibiraatti kaffalaa
title.en: Pay any remaining tax at the tax office

detail.am: ከወረቀቶችዎ ጋር በንግድ ሥራ ቢሮው ያቅርቡ።
detail.om: Warqeewwan kee waliin waajjira daldalaa dhiyeessaa.
detail.en: Submit it with your papers at the trade office.

detail.om: Bankii fi waajjirawwan biraaf barbaachisuu danda'a.
detail.en: You may need it for banks and other offices.

fees.amount: PLACEHOLDER — often free if taxes are settled (verify)

estimatedTime.om: Gibira qulqulleeffame yoo ta'e guyyoota 1–3 dhiyoo; waajjiratti mirkaneessaa
estimatedTime.en: About 1–3 days if taxes are settled (confirm at the office)

text.am: የግብር ማጽዳቢያ ያለ ንግድ ቢሮ ማመልከቻ አይቀበልም — መጀመሪያ ግብር ቢሮ ይሂዱ

text.en: The trade office will not start without tax clearance — go to the tax office first

text.am: ዋናውን ፈቃድ ካላመጡ ቢሮው ማረጋገጫ አይሰጥም
text.om: Hayyama guutuu boothin waajjirichi mirkaneessa hin kennu
text.en: Without the original license the office cannot cancel it

text.am: ፈቃዱ ሳይሰርዝ ንግድ መቀጠል ቅጣት ሊያስከትል ይችላል
text.om: Hayyamni hin haqameen daldala itti fufuun adabbii fiduu danda'a
text.en: Trading after closing without cancelling the license can bring a fine

shortDescription.en: Get a permit to invest in Ethiopia.

text.en: Copy of passport or ID
Business plan
Tax identification number (TIN)
Lease agreement for land or office

detail.am: ለክልሎች የራሳቸው ቢሮዎች አሏቸው — የእርስዎ የት እንደሆነ ይጠይቁ።
detail.om: Mootummoota naannoo waajjira mataa isaanii qabu — kan isin aannuu gaafadhaa.
detail.en: Regions have their own offices — ask which one serves you.

detail.am: ጥያቄ ካለ ወደኋላ ወረቀት ሊጠይቁዎት ይችላሉ።
detail.om: Gaaffii yoo jiraate warqee dabalataa isin gaafatu.
detail.en: They may ask questions or ask for more papers.

estimatedTime.am: በፕሮጀክቱ መሠረት ከቀናት እስከ ሳምንታት፤ ቢሮውን ያረጋግጡ
estimatedTime.om: Projektii irraa hundaa'ee guyyaa hanga torban — waajjiratti mirkaneessaa
estimatedTime.en: From a few days to weeks, depending on the project (confirm)

text.am: ወጪና ተስፋውን ትርፍ ያልጻፈበት እቅድ ውድቅ ወይም መዘግየት ያስከትላል

text.en: A plan without costs and expected income gets delayed or rejected

text.om: Galmeeffuu dura TIN qabaachaa kee mirkaneessaa
text.en: Check that your TIN is ready before you register

text.am: ፈቃዱ የሚቆይበት ጊዜ አለው — ጊዜው ያለፈ በኋላ ማደስ ያስፈልጋል
text.om: Hayyamni yeroon isaa qaba — yeroo darbee booda haaraa gochuu barbaachisa
text.en: Permits have a validity period — renew it if it expires before you start

Pay the lease at the bank

detail.om: Guyyaa safarri ta'ee iddotti akka jiraattan gaafatamuu dandeessa.
detail.en: You may be asked to be present on site on the day.

fees.amount: PLACEHOLDER — depends on land size and location (verify)

estimatedTime.am: በቢሮው ከቀናት እስከ ሳምንታት ሊወስድ ይችላል፤ ያረጋግጡ
estimatedTime.om: Guyyaa hanga torban fudhachuu danda'a; waajjiratti mirkaneessaa
estimatedTime.en: Can take days to weeks, depending on the office (confirm)

text.am: ያለ ኦፊሴላዊ ማስረጃ መክፈል አይሆንም — ማስረጃውን ሁልጊዜ ይያዙ
text.om: Ragaa ofiisiyaalaa malee kaffaluun hin ta'u — ragaa yeroo hunda qabadhaa
text.en: Never pay without an official receipt — always keep it

text.om: Maqaan kee dogoggoraan yoo barreeffame, hin baatin dura sirreessaa
text.en: If your name is misspelled on the paper, fix it before you leave

text.am: ድንበርና መጠኑን ከማረጋገጥዎ በፊት መፈረም ብጥብጥ ያመጣል

shortDescription.en: Transfer property to another person or to heirs.

text.en: Title deed
ID of both parties

text.om: Ragaa dhaalaa ykn waliigaltee gurgura/kennaa (haala keessanitti)
text.en: Inheritance paper or sale/gift agreement, depending on your case
Tax clearance

detail.am: ውርስ ከሆነ የፍርድ ቤት ወረቀት ያግኙ፤ ሽያጭ ወይም መስጠት ከሆነ ስምምነቱን በሚገባ ይፈርሙ።

detail.en: For inheritance, get a court letter; for sale or gift, sign the agreement at the right office.

title.am: ሁለቱም ወገኖች ወደ መሬት ምዝገባ ይሂዱ

detail.om: Baay'een lamaanu akka ofii isaanii jiraatan barbaachisa.
detail.en: Usually both must be present in person.

title.am: በአዲሱ ባለቤት ስም አዲስ ዲድ ወረቀት ይውሰዱ
title.om: Deedii haaraa maqaa abbaa haaraa fudhaa
title.en: Collect the new deed in the new owner's name

fees.amount: PLACEHOLDER — usually a percent of the property value (verify)

estimatedTime.om: Baay'een torban fudhata; dhaalan dheerachuu danda'a — mirkaneessaa
estimatedTime.en: Usually several weeks; inheritance can take longer (confirm)

text.om: Tokko yoo hin jiraatin gatiijjiirumaan hin hojjetu

text.om: Ragaa dhaalaa malee qabeenya dhaalaa gatiijjiruun hin danda'amu
text.en: Inherited property cannot be transferred without inheritance papers

text.am: ያልተከፈሉ የድሮ የመሬት ግብሮች ዝውውሩን ያቆማሉ — መጀመሪያ ይክፈሉ
text.om: Gibira dachee duraan hin kaffalamme gatiijjiirumaa dhaaba — dura kaffalaa
text.en: Unpaid old land taxes stop the transfer — clear them first

shortDescription.en: Get a building permit before you construct.

Architectural drawing by a licensed professional
Your ID

title.en: Hire a licensed architect or engineer

detail.en: They prepare the drawings the city accepts.

title.am: ንድፉንና ወረቀቶችዎን የግንባታ ፈቃድ ቢሮ ያቅርቡ

title.en: Submit drawings and papers to the building permit office

detail.en: City staff may visit your plot to check it.

title.en: Collect the permit before you start building

detail.am: ብዙ ጊዜ ፈቃዱን በግንባታው ስፍራ ላይ ያስቀምጡ።
detail.en: It is usual to post the permit at the construction site.

fees.amount: PLACEHOLDER — depends on building size and use (verify)

estimatedTime.am: ብዙ ጊዜ ለሳምንታት፤ የንድፍ ማጽደቅ ቀኑን ይወስናል፤ ያረጋግጡ
estimatedTime.om: Baay'een torban fudhata; ragaa dizaayiniin guyyaa murteessa — mirkaneessaa
estimatedTime.en: Usually weeks; approval of the drawings sets the timing (confirm)

text.am: ፈቃድ ሳያገኙ መገንባት ቅጣት ወይም ማፍረስ ሊያስከትል ይችላል
text.om: Hayyama malee ijaraa jalqabuun adabbii ykn buqqa'uu fiduu danda'a
text.en: Building before the permit arrives can bring a fine or demolition

text.am: በሙያ ያልተፈቀደላቸው የተሠሩ ንድፎች ውድቅ ይደራሉ
text.en: Drawings not made by a licensed professional are rejected

text.am: ከተስማማው ንድፍ ውጭ መገንባት ችግር ያመጣል
text.om: Dizaayinii ragaa cinaa ijaraan rakkoo fidu
text.en: Building differently from the approved drawing causes problems
Your ID
Lease or holding certificate
Land or lease payment receipts

title.am: ወደ ቀበሌዎ ወይም የከተማ አስተዳደር መሬት ቢሮ ይሂዱ
title.om: Gara kilee keessanii ykn waajjira dachee magaalaa deemaa
title.en: Go to your kebele or city land office
The office checks the plot records

estimatedTime.am: ከ1–3 ሳምንት ገደማ፤ በቢሮው ይለያያል፤ ያረጋግጡ

text.am: የድሮ የክፍያ ማስረጃዎች ማጣት መያዝዎን ማረጋገጥ ያስቸግራል
text.om: Ragaa kaffaltii duraan dhabuun dhiyoo waggaa hedduu qabachuu kee mirkaneessuu rakkisa
text.en: Losing old payment receipts makes proving long holding harder

text.om: Maqaan kee yoo jijjiirame (fkn gaa'elumaa danda'a) warqee irratti sirreessaa
text.en: If your name changed (e.g. by marriage), update the certificate

text.am: በውርስ ወይም በግዢ ካስተላለፉ በኋላ ምዝገባውን በፍጥከት ያስተካክሉ — ብጥብጥን ይቀንሳል
text.om: Dhaala ykn bituu booda galmee dhuunfaa sirreessaa — walitti bu'iinsa hir'isa
text.en: After inheriting or buying, update the registration quickly — it prevents disputes
